entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Liborio Solís is a Venezuelan professional boxer who held WBA super flyweight title in 2013. He also challenged once for the WBC bantamweight title in 2016 and three times for the WBA bantamweight title in 2016, 2017, and 2023.
